settings.repere: Paragraphe · Are there options for how I can wear t…
settings.text: Are there options for how I can wear the straps on the CrossOver Bra?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes! The CrossOver Bra has adjustable …
settings.text: Yes! The CrossOver Bra has adjustable straps that can be worn traditionally over the shoulders or crisscrossed in the front or back. The crisscross style is perfect for accommodating different outfit styles, like racerback tops, and also provides extra support.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · If the CrossOver Bra doesn’t have unde…
settings.text: If the CrossOver Bra doesn’t have underwire, how does it provide support?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Our CrossOver Bra is equipped with a b…
settings.text: Our CrossOver Bra is equipped with a bonded cradle that's stabilized at the center front. Additionally, side-bust boning keeps your chest centered. Full coverage, molded foam cups provide extra shaping and support. Wide wings and a supportive band also add stability while maximizing comfort.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · How should I wash and care for the Cro…
settings.text: How should I wash and care for the CrossOver Bra?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The ideal method to care for your Cros…
settings.text: The ideal method to care for your CrossOver Bra is by handwashing and air drying. If that doesn't work for you, don't worry! You can machine wash it on a delicate cycle with cold water and similar colors. Always remember to air dry.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · What breast shape is best suited for t…
settings.text: What breast shape is best suited for the CrossOver Bra?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The CrossOver Bra is best suited for a…
settings.text: The CrossOver Bra is best suited for asymmetrical or pendulous relaxed breasts.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · What solution does the CrossOver Bra p…
settings.text: What solution does the CrossOver Bra provide?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The CrossOver Bra is great if you're l…
settings.text: The CrossOver Bra is great if you're looking for a bra with all day comfort, back and side smoothing, with full bust support!
